title: Our Space
seoDescription: The Together Wellness studio on Mos Lane, Mosman Park: a reformer studio, a clinical Pilates studio, treatment rooms and a lounge, designed with Pattern Studio.

blocks.text: Inspired by the natural warmth and relaxed rhythm of coastal Western Australia, our space has been thoughtfully designed to balance movement with moments of pause.

blocks.heading: Vision
paragraphs: Natural materials, warm textures and considered details create an environment that feels as welcoming as it is restorative.
A place where the experience of arriving, moving and spending time matters just as much as the care you receive.

slides.alt: Reception lounge with timber joinery and a planted pot
slides.caption: Reception. Artist’s impression

blocks.heading: Design
paragraphs: The studio has been designed with Pattern Studio. Timber joinery, textured walls and soft, warm light carry through every room, from the reception desk to the treatment rooms.
Each space has been planned around how people move through a visit: arriving, changing, moving and taking a moment before heading back into the day.

blocks.heading: Reformer studio
paragraphs: A light-filled studio for Group Reformer, Strength, and Ante and Postnatal classes, with room for up to 12 people per class.

blocks.heading: Clinical Pilates studio
paragraphs: A separate studio for clinical Pilates, set up for small groups of up to four people working with one physiotherapist.

slides.alt: Clinical Pilates studio with trapeze table and chair
slides.caption: Clinical Pilates studio. Artist’s impression

slides.alt: Trapeze table in front of a timber screen
slides.caption: Clinical Pilates studio. Artist’s impression

blocks.heading: Treatment rooms
paragraphs: Private rooms for physiotherapy appointments, a short walk from the studios, so moving between treatment and classes is simple.

blocks.heading: Lounge
paragraphs: More than a place to exercise. A lounge to arrive early, stay a while after class, or simply sit for a moment before the rest of your day.

blocks.heading: Location
paragraphs: Our first studio is on Mos Lane in Mosman Park, between the river and the coast.

slides.caption: Mos Lane frontage. Artist’s impression
